Don’t get fooled by the fancy setup and large space. Once you actually start using the gym, you realize the equipment quality is pretty average and not worth the hype at all. A lot of the machines feel outdated or cheaply put together.

What annoyed me the most was the way the management handled the trial session. I clearly asked beforehand and was simply told to come over, with zero mention of any fee. After the session was over, the owner, Ishwarpreet, suddenly asked for ₹500. When I pointed out that nobody informed me earlier, instead of accepting the mistake he tried to justify it by saying it should have been understood automatically. Very shady way of dealing with potential customers.

Plenty of better and more transparent gyms around.
